reason: Primary user-facing purpose is UI text customization: the plugin replaces DeepSeek Harness turn-status copy with configurable, phase-aware phrases and optional animated effects inside the web UI, plus a settings page for editing those phrases and timing options. Evidence also shows node-side config serving/persistence and a companion script that can build local configs from external OneBot-compatible APIs, so behavior is mostly low-to-moderate risk with local file/network interaction.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH Web 插件，用于将回合状态行文案替换为可配置的中文/英文短语并按阶段轮播，支持打字机与彩色渐变效果，并提供设置页编辑文本与参数。
summaries.en: This plugin for DSH Web replaces the turn-status label with configurable Chinese/English phrases, rotates them by phase with optional typewriter and gradient effects, and provides a settings page to edit phrase banks and timing options.

capabilities: Replaces a specific DSH Web turn-status UI text and displays rotating, phase-aware phrases.
Provides user-configurable behavior and display options (rotation timing, typewriter speed, gradient rendering).
Node side can read and write plugin configuration via local file endpoints used by the settings page.
Can generate phrase-config files from external QQ group/member data sources via an HTTP API script.

reasons.code: README documents that the plugin replaces the DSH turn-status label with custom phrases and supports phase-aware rotation, typewriter output, and optional rainbow gradient.
README describes a browser settings page that saves full JSON and the node side writes/serves `config.json`, with optional external/local configuration sources.
package.json shows the project is a DSH web plugin with bundle patch metadata and client injection hooks.
README documents `scripts/fetch-qq-group.cjs` that accepts OneBot HTTP URL/token and fetches group member data to generate local config files.
